note: Names to WATCH FOR but not track. Anything listed here that an answer names, and that is not in your `brands` table, shows up in the dashboard's 'Named but not tracked' panel — the shortlist of competitors worth adding. Matching is literal and case-insensitive, the same rule the brands table uses, so put the spellings an engine would actually write. This file ships empty on purpose: geo-tracker makes no judgement about who competes with you. Fill it with the vendors in your category. Editing it re-derives the whole history on the next scheduler tick, so a name added today is scored against answers already stored.
